findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping in document lookups
findings.body: When document IDs overlap across tenants—or a caller learns another tenant's ID—`getDocument` still receives `ctx.tenantId`, but the changed call discards it and `loadDocument` queries only `{ documentId }`. The result can therefore depend on database ordering or disclose another tenant's document. Keep `tenantId` in the lookup predicate.
